purpose: Prove that the AgentBridge Ollama runtime job was admitted to the intended machine before any cognition proof is credited.
admission_invariants: The workflow MUST retain the OURSELFPIMAC label.
A run with startup_failure and zero jobs is NOT runtime execution.
No cognition receipt may be credited until a job reaches in_progress or completed with an executed proof step.
Generic self-hosted substitution is forbidden for this proof.
alchemy_rule: Declaration of runner identity is not evidence of runner admission; only an executed job on the selected runner can establish admission.
